The geneId, proteinId, and hugoSymbol query parameters are independent optional filters; if none are provided, all transcripts are returned;
In the request body ensemblFilter, exactly one of the arrays transcriptIds, hugoSymbols, proteinIds, or geneIds should be provided and non-empty (Only One);

At least one of transcriptIds, hugoSymbols, proteinIds, or geneIds must be provided in the request body; if more than one are supplied simultaneously, the request should be treated as invalid or ambiguous;
